Package io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling

Class SchedulingBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.scheduling.SchedulingBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
CpSatProblem<EmployeeRoster>, OptimizationProblem<EmployeeRoster>
public final class SchedulingBuilder extends Object implements CpSatProblem<EmployeeRoster>
Fluent builder for employee scheduling problems. Entry point: Optimize.scheduling().

    • shift

      public SchedulingBuilder shift(String id, Consumer<ShiftConfig> config)
      Declares a shift with the given unique id and configures it via the ShiftConfig lambda. A recurring shift (every/daily/on(DayOfWeek)) is expanded into one instance per matching date when the problem is built; all instances report this id.

    • assign

      public SchedulingBuilder assign(String employeeId, String shiftId)
      Forces employeeId onto every instance of shiftId. The employee must be eligible (skill, availability) for each instance; validated when the problem is built.

    • assign

      public SchedulingBuilder assign(String employeeId, String shiftId, LocalDate date)
      Forces employeeId onto the instance of shiftId that falls on date.
